name: theme
title: Theme
description: Omarchy palette themes mapped onto shadcn tokens: parser, built-in palettes, a pre-paint head script, provider with a D hotkey, and a circular reveal.

color13 = "#9a5266"
color14 = "#3e8a84"

mode = "light"

red = "#b0281e"
green = "#5e6b33"
yellow = "#a9791f"
blue = "#3e5a78"
magenta = "#7e3b4e"
cyan = "#2e6e6a"
